kicker: Defence & aerospace · orders won vs revenue billed
title: BEL won ₹49 of orders for every ₹100 it billed
dek: Bharat Electronics' Q2 sales rose 27%, but it has won ₹7,334 cr of a ₹55,000 cr FY27 order goal, with QRSAM now expected in March or April. ideaForge's order book fell 21%.

read: Defence sales this year are coming out of existing order books; whether QRSAM and the corvette orders are signed by March sets FY28.
sources: Vantage analysis of Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE and Q1–Q2 FY27 earnings calls; Vantage sector intel, 20 Nov 2026
notes: Book-to-bill for Q2 FY27 = orders won in the quarter ÷ revenue from filed Q2 results (consolidated). Data Patterns (₹929 cr) and Zen (₹481.8 cr) stated Q2 inflow on their calls; BEL's Q2 inflow is its FY27-to-1-October orders (₹7,334 cr) less Q1 inflow (₹3,754 cr); ideaForge's and Cyient DLM's are derived from the change in order book plus revenue (ideaForge ₹256.8 cr to ₹202.2 cr; Cyient DLM ₹2,599 cr to ₹2,810 cr, consistent with its ≈₹600 cr stated). Only companies with Q2 figures on the desk are shown; HAL, Bharat Dynamics, GRSE, Solar and Astra had no comparable Q2 inflow. One quarter of defence orders is lumpy, and Data Patterns' ratio is flattered by a weak Q2 revenue base.
